description:
ASE is a diverse school focusing on the connections between geosciences, ecology, society and Earth systems. Our approach integrates these disciplines to examine big environmental challenges both in Southeast Asia and globally. We conduct cutting-edge research on topics that include ecology, geohazards, climate change, sea-level rise, environmental sustainability, conservation of environment and biodiversity, and interactions between environment and society. For more information on ASE please visit https://www.ntu.edu.sg/ase.

The Climate Transformation Programme (CTP) aims to develop, inspire and accelerate knowledge-based solutions and educate future leaders to establish the stable climate and environment necessary for resilient, just, and sustainable Southeast Asian societies.

CTP will generate knowledge and innovation across disciplines including climate and Earth science, ecology, materials science, artificial intelligence, humanities, social sciences and the arts, finance, health, and engineering. It will also translate state-of-the-art scientific results into real world solutions for Singapore, and it will transfer these solutions to Southeast Asia (SEA) and beyond.

Cluster 3: Climate Mitigation focuses on scalable carbon dioxide removal (CDR) and decarbonisation solutions relevant to Singapore and Southeast Asia.

We are seeking a Research Fellow or Senior Research Fellow to lead research in mineral-based carbon sequestration and engineered CDR systems. The role will involve developing monitoring and verification frameworks, conducting environmental impact studies, and supporting translation of research into real-world applications in collaboration with academic, government, and industry partners.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead research in carbon dioxide removal and mineral-based mitigation approaches
* Develop MRV methodologies and environmental monitoring frameworks
* Conduct field, laboratory, and modelling studies
* Publish research and contribute to policy-relevant outputs
* Support collaboration with industry and public-sector partners
* Mentor junior researchers and contribute to programme development

**Job Requirements:**

* PhD in a relevant discipline (e.g. geoscience, environmental science, oceanography)
* Strong research track record in climate mitigation or related fields
* Experience in interdisciplinary and applied research
* Strong communication and teamwork skills

ASE seeks a diverse and inclusive workforce and is committed to equality of opportunity. We welcome applications from all and recruit on the basis of merit, regardless of age, race, gender, religion, marital status and family responsibilities, or disability.

Interested applicants should submit a cover letter, CV, and contact details of three referees. Review of applications will begin straight away.

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.

* To prepare and deliver reports, presentations and workshops to internal and external teams and clients.

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.

You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

* Certified accredited professional of sustainability rating system (e.g. LEED, GBI, Green Mark, WELL, Living Building Challenge).
* Analysis and interpretation skills in solar radiation, CFD, thermal comfort, energy modelling, daylighting, glare and whole life carbon assessment.
* Basic knowledge of building physics and understanding of main aspects of active/passive strategies for buildings and masterplans.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Good literacy and numeracy skills.
* Passion for sustainability and design analytics.
* Knowledge and interest in sustainable building design in terms of both energy and carbon, challenging yourself and the rest of the design team to achieve the optimum outcome for the project. Good understanding of net zero transitions, including operational and embodied carbon.

description:
About the Role
  
As the EHS Officer you will lead the development and implementation of health, safety and environmental initiatives in the data centre. You will ensure compliance with local regulations, support the client’s global EHS mission, and foster a proactive safety culture that protects people, the planet, and the business.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Leadership
  
  
Promote a positive and proactive safety culture across all stakeholders.
  
  
Assist the Critical Facilities Manager (CFM) in implementing EHS playbooks and procedures.
  
  
Coordinate vendor health and safety access to site and oversee the safe execution of works, including vendor employee registration and ensuring all method statements and risk assessments are available, accurate, and approved.
  
  
Monitor and manage operational and safety risks, including injury and incident reporting.
  
  
Conduct regular safety audits and risk assessments across critical infrastructure.
  
  
Ensure compliance with Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) regulations and ESG standards.
  
Strategic Alignment with the Clients’ EHS Mission
  
  
Empower people through training and awareness programs.
  
  
Support the client’s governance, risk, and compliance efforts by maintaining high safety standards.
  
  
Enhance ESG performance by integrating sustainable fire safety and EHS practices.
  
  
Collaborate cross-functionally to improve EHS systems, technologies, and controls.
  
  
Monitor emerging risks and trends that may impact business or community safety.
  
Qualifications & Skills
  
  
Bachelor’s Degree preferred; 5+ years of relevant experience in EHS in facilities management or similar industry.
  
  
Valid WSH Officer license with the Ministry of Manpower (Singapore).
  
  
Additional certifications are an advantage.
  
  
Strong leadership and communication skills to influence and guide stakeholders.
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  
  
Ability to manage sensitive and complex safety issues with strategic insight.
